run_CC100Reader: run the CC100Reader pipeline step to process a single language from CC-100 xz files into JSONL output
create_CC100Reader: create a CC100Reader instance that extends PipelineStep to read multilingual CC-100 data
run_SlurmPipelineExecutor: run SlurmPipelineExecutor with CC100Reader to launch 120 parallel tasks across languages on a Slurm cluster
test_CC100Reader_run: test the CC100Reader run method with a specific rank to process one language from compressed text files
review_CC100Reader: review the CC100Reader class that reads xz-compressed multilingual text files and writes Document objects as JSONL
